annotations.kubernetes.io/limit-ranger: LimitRanger plugin set: ephemeral-storage request for container load; ephemeral-storage limit for container load

args:
curl -s "$CH" --data 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events(ts DateTime DEFAULT now(), user UInt32, action String) ENGINE=MergeTree ORDER BY ts TTL ts + INTERVAL 7 DAY'
rows=""; n=$((50 + $(date +%s) % 100))
i=0; while [ $i -lt $n ]; do rows="$rows(now(),$((RANDOM%1000)),'action-$((RANDOM%20))'),"; i=$((i+1)); done
curl -s "$CH" --data-binary "INSERT INTO events(ts,user,action) VALUES ${rows%,}"
echo "insert $n rows"
curl -s "$CH" --data 'SELECT action, count() c FROM events GROUP BY action ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 5 FORMAT TabSeparated'
curl -s "$CH" --data 'SELECT count() FROM events'
echo "clickhouse load done"
containers.name: load

args:
R="redis-cli -h $REDISHOST -a $REDISPW --no-auth-warning"
n=$((30 + RANDOM % 40))
for i in $(seq 1 $n); do $R set "session:$RANDOM" "user-data-$RANDOM" EX $((300 + RANDOM % 3000)) >/dev/null; done
$R incrby counter:visits $n >/dev/null
$R dbsize
$R info keyspace | head -3
echo "redis load done: $n keys"
containers.name: load

args: trap true INT TERM; sleep infinity & wait
command:
work_dir="$(pwd)"
mkdir -p "$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nats"
cd "$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nats"
if ! [ -s context ]; then
  ln -s /etc/nats-contexts context
fi
if ! [ -f context.txt ]; then
  echo -n "default" > context.txt
fi
cd "$work_dir"
exec /entrypoint.sh "$@"
containers.name: nats-box
